plainTranslation: With Composite Neptune in the 7th house, you may not see the relationship as it is actually is. You can see it how you want to see it, and you have to work on being more realistic. It may be difficult for you to grasp balance together, but you can work hard to get along well and treat each other with respect. You may not be aware when the other person is having an issue though, so you need to be more open.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
